title: Among Us Emergency Meeting
blurb: Slam the button in the cafeteria and everyone gets dragged to the table, wherever they were and whatever they were doing. The emergency meeting sting is two seconds of pure escalation, and by late 2020 it had escaped the game entirely — it became the standard way to open an argument, a group chat callout, or a video where somebody is about to be accused of something. InnerSloth released the game in 2018 and almost nobody noticed until streamers found it. Now the sound alone is enough to make people brace.
origin: The emergency meeting sting from Among Us (InnerSloth, 2018).
